svg.title: Our office cities
svg.desc: Five separate dotted country silhouettes, left to right: Riyadh in Saudi Arabia; Dubai in the United Arab Emirates; Karachi in Pakistan; Dhaka in Bangladesh; Kathmandu in Nepal. Blue city markers have white halos. Published Natural Earth 1:50 million country geometry projected with D3 Mercator; GeoNames city coordinates. Each country is scaled independently. City-level locations, not street addresses.
